Flow.description: Inserts the Provider Objection Cases built by Log a Visit (Provider_SCR_LogVisitReport_Refined). Runs in system context with sharing because Region and Case Origin are read-only for liaisons by design (and Origin has no FLS for BH PRM User), so a user-mode insert fails. An insert error is caught and returned in vT_ErrorMessage (subflow elements have no fault path in the caller), and the calling flow then rolls the whole visit back.
Flow.label: Case AL Create Objection Cases

recordCreates.description: One insert for every objection Case on the visit. Ids are written back to vC_Cases for the caller.
recordCreates.name: Create_Objection_Cases
recordCreates.label: Create Objection Cases

variables.description: The objection Cases to insert. Returned with their new Ids.
variables.name: vC_Cases

variables.description: The insert error message when the Cases could not be saved; blank on success.
